# PlayGrid Account & Authentication (llms.txt)

> PlayGrid Account is the unified Single Sign-On (SSO) identity service for PlayGrid.

- [Login](https://account.playgrid.vn/vi/login): Sign In
- [Register](https://account.playgrid.vn/vi/register): Create Player Account
- [Terms](https://playgrid.vn/vi/terms): Terms of Service
- [Privacy](https://playgrid.vn/vi/privacy): Privacy Policy
- [Main Portal](https://playgrid.vn): PlayGrid Web
